services.name: Swim Team
services.desc: UVAC is now offering Private Adaptive Swim Lessons! We specialize in working with individuals who have autism, anxiety, sensory needs, motor challenges, or those who learn differently. Children and young adults with various disabilities are the heart of this program. Our Adaptive Swim Whisperers® Certified instructors use a teaching approach that enables them to connect with these swimmers on their level so they gain vital water safety skills. The Adaptive Swim Whisperers® multi-level certification program is designed to facilitate swim success for individuals with special needs. Training teaches how to assess and identify roadblocks, and how to apply the correct strategy to overcome them.

services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: We offer semi-private and private swim lessons for children and adults of all abilities at our White River Junction, VT, New London, NH, and Claremont, NH locations. They are a great solution for individuals who have a fear of the water or just need extra attention to advance their swimming skills. Please Note: Our private lesson request form for lessons in White River Junction is currently closed due to the number of swimmers on the waitlist. Please reach out to Meredith Boyle (mboyle@uvacswim.org) with any questions!
